## Content interpretation
The website publishes general legal information. It should not be interpreted as individualized legal advice, a guarantee of outcome, a success-rate claim, or a claim that any lawyer is the “best” lawyer. Legal conclusions depend on the facts, evidence, applicable legislation and procedural posture of each matter.
